{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Actor3''', which uses the display name of just '''Actor''', was a summon only enemy in [[The Narratorium]] as part of [[The Final Act Event]]. Originally, it was the last actor that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It has high health, though it is slower than the previous actors. '''Actor3''' has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning it cannot be stunned and only slowed down and [[Freeze Immunity]], meaning it cannot be frozen or chilled. It can be spawned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]], [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]], [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]. ==Logbook Description== "''This actor dreamt of passing through a portal into a theater where an illuminated cube waited at its center. They could have sworn an impressive battle had taken place, but the closer they got to the memory, the more it faded away. Eventually, their daydream snapped to reality—sitting on a Ferris Wheel, overlooking the wooden bridges.''" ==Appearance== '''Actor3''' is a black humanoid that wears a tuxedo suit. It also wears a black top hat, white and red bowtie and a white theatre mask. It holds a black cane with its right arm and holds its top hat in place with its left arm. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] and [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Engineer]] can be used to deal with this. *Due to its immunities, it cannot be frozen or knocked back, and stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of fully stopping it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} Actor3Walk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseActor3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} Actor3IconIG.png|'''Actor3''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was first used in [[The Great Finale]] as part of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
